definitions.short: Cuth or Cuthah , a province of Assyria
definitions.full: H3575. Kuth or Kuthah כּוּת כּוּתָה, proper name, of a location whence king of Assyria (Sargon) transported colonists into Northern Israel, מִכּוּתָה 2Kin 17:4 , אַנְשֵׁיכֿוּת 17:30 ; Babylonian Kûtû, Kûtê , modern Tel-Ibrahim, approximately 20 miles northeast from Babylon, see COT 17:24 Dl Par 217 M-A JBL 1892, xi. 169 .
